summary: Tested the enriched Portfolio PDF export end-to-end (backend API + UI-triggered download). Verified structural, content, and formatting requirements from the review request against actual rendered PDFs for both the rich-data account (Demo User, 12 pages, 28,915 bytes) and the empty-data admin account (Test Admin, 1 page). All acceptance criteria pass. The on-screen My Portfolio page was spot-checked and remains unaffected (no frontend changes this round).

issues: Pre-existing (NOT introduced by this task): Action items whose due_date in the DB is a non-ISO string (e.g., literal "Friday") render as 'Due: Invalid Date' on-screen. The PDF handles this gracefully by falling back to the raw value ('Due: Friday'). Only mentioned here for awareness — out of scope for this backend-only PDF task.

demo_user_rich (12 pages, 28,915 bytes): Page 1 navy header band with eyebrow 'SUPERVISION 2.0 · STAFF EVIDENCE PORTFOLIO', name 'Demo User', 'Attendee · user@supervision.com'
Meetings/Last Supervision row shows '15 Sept 2026' (en-GB Sept, NOT raw ISO)
Stat row 1: CQC Regulations 17 | Care Cert Standards 11 | Custom Criteria 30 | Total 131
Stat row 2 (NEW): Open Actions 6 | Open Learning Needs 3 | Achievements 19 | Register Items 33
NEW sections present in correct order BEFORE CQC: Actions → Learning Needs → Achievements → CQC Regulatory Evidence → Care Certificate Evidence → Organisational Standards Evidence → Meeting History
Status labels colored correctly: OUTSTANDING (amber), OVERDUE (red), COMPLETE (green), STANDING (indigo), ACHIEVEMENT (green)
Outstanding-then-completed ordering confirmed in Actions/Learning Needs sections
'Rolled over' badges render on rolled-over outstanding Actions
'Meeting: {title} — {date}' line present on every item with formatted date (e.g., '15 Sept 2026', '9 Sept 2026', '17 Aug 2026')
'Completed: {date}' line present on COMPLETE items (e.g., 'Completed: 17 Oct 2026')
Achievements items read-only — only 'ACHIEVEMENT' label, no due/completed
CQC/Care Cert/Organisational sections unchanged in content, all 'Meetings:' dates formatted (17 Aug 2026, 8 Sept 2026, 15 Sept 2026)
Meeting History table dates formatted '15 Sept 2026 / 8 Sept 2026 / 17 Aug 2026'
Footer: 'Generated by 1two.one on 17 Oct 2026 12:22 UTC. Confidential.' — formatted, no raw ISO

No Actions / Learning Needs / Achievements empty-section headers rendered (correctly omitted)
No CQC/Care Cert/Organisational/Meeting History sections (correctly omitted)
Last Supervision = '—' placeholder (no crash on None date)
verified_pdf_content.ui_triggered_download: Admin logged in via browser, navigated to /portfolio/{demo_user_id}, clicked data-testid=export-portfolio-btn — download fired, file saved as 'portfolio_Demo_User.pdf' (12 pages, 28,915 bytes, identical bytes to curl-based download). UI integration confirmed working.
verified_pdf_content.button_disabled_when_empty: The Export Portfolio PDF button is correctly disabled on the Admin's own portfolio view (frontend condition `disabled={stats.total_meetings === 0}` in StaffPortfolio.js:491). Empty-data PDF generation was verified via direct API call — produces a valid 1-page PDF with no errors.

critical_code_review_comments: fmt_date() silently returns str(value) when parsing fails — this is why literal 'Friday' leaks through as 'Due: Friday' in the PDF. Not a regression but same underlying data-quality issue the frontend 'Invalid Date' bug exposes. Consider logging/warning on unparseable dates so the data can be cleaned, or coercing to '—'.

_generate_portfolio_pdf has now grown to ~385 lines in a single function; the three repeated CQC/CareCert/Organisational section builders (lines ~696-794) are near-duplicates. Low-priority refactor target for a future cleanup pass.
